```markdown
- Create Awareness
  - Teaser Campaign
    - Short video clips and images on social media

  - Customer testimonials and reviews
- Build Interest
  - Limited time offers and discounts
  - Interactive virtual tour
- Monitor and Evaluate

  - Analyze social media insights and adjust strategy accordingly
```
